career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest occupational risk is intelligent transportation combined with role reduction. Adaptive signals and monitoring reduce manual optimization, but people still conduct field surveys and coordinate construction. Project-based work also fluctuates.
risks: Monitoring is absorbed by assistance tools

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent systems become, technicians still decide whether to change a location, how to route around road occupation, and whether the site is safe. Their feet survey, their eyes verify, and their hands sign. People cannot be fully removed from traffic coordination.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI 本体，而是「智能交通 + 减岗」——调优被吃，但踏勘协调的锅还得人背。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「智能交通 + 岗位收缩」——自适应信号和监测减小人工调优，但现场踏勘和施工协调仍要人；且项目制波动。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，这点要不要改、占道怎么绕、现场安不安全，最后还是技术员的脚去踏、眼去核、手去签——调度这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but remaining a machine tender without learning programming. As automation spreads, people who master machines become more valuable, while those who cannot face greater danger.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk to the occupation is not AI, but changing skill requirements as automation rises. Robotic arms replace simple loading and machine-tending roles, while versatile operators who adjust parameters, program, and troubleshoot become scarcer.
risks: Robotic arms and AI replace simple machine-tending roles
Occupational-health risks from workshop arc light, spatter, and noise
Rising skill requirements narrow the path for people who do not learn programming
Piece-rate and performance income fluctuates between busy and slow seasons
Insufficient automation investment at smaller factories creates job polarization

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can optimize parameters and identify defects, but the operator still fixtures workpieces, listens to the machine to judge weld quality, and stops the line to resolve faults. As automation spreads, people who master the machines become more valuable.

responsibilities: Fixture workpieces and operate welding machines
Monitor weld quality and resolve faults

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「停在看机不学编程」——自动化越普及，能驾驭机器的人越值钱，不能驾驭的越危险。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「自动化程度提升后岗位技能要求变化」——简单上料看护岗被机械手替代，但会调参、会编程、能处理异常的复合操作工反而更稀缺。
risks: 简单看机岗被机械手与 AI 替代
车间弧光飞溅与噪音，职业健康风险
技能门槛提高，不学编程路越走越窄
计件与绩效收入，旺季淡季波动
中小厂自动化投入不足，岗位分化

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能优化参数、识别缺陷，但装夹工件、听机器声音判断「这刀焊得好不好」、停机处置异常的那个人，还得是操作工——自动化越普及，能驾驭机器的人越值钱。

responsibilities: 监控焊缝质量并处置异常
skills: 自动焊机与机器人操作
